title: Infuser during Storm Cloud: heal per enemy in the cloud, and does an item cast keep the channel
question: Does Infuser's active (70% spirit lifesteal, +30 spirit, 7 s x duration) heal ~0.70 x storm damage per hero in the cloud, scaling with hero count, and can it be popped during the channel without ending it?
hypothesis: H-L1a: heal(3 bots) / heal(1 bot) >= 2.5 (no AoE lifesteal cut). H-L1b: Infuser cast after the storm starts leaves storm damage within 10% of the pre-pop arm. Prediction at 24.8k state: heal over the Infuser window ~1.8k per bot (model wx7/model.py).

arms.name: INF_mid
arms.notes: cast 4, wait 2, cast i1 (during channel), enemies 3

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: setup Gigawatt Haze; souls 24800; unlock 7; give arm items; basemods
enemies N 300 8; fetch 350; lowhp 50; healreset; mark storm
arm order of casts; wait 22 (whole channel)
mark none; record healDiffObserved and storm damage rows per bot per second

metrics.name: storm_dmg_per_bot
metrics.how: damage csv, ability Storm Cloud, per victim

decision.rule: INF_3bot/INF_1bot >= 2.5 supports full AoE lifesteal; INF_mid storm_seconds within 10% of INF_1bot supports in-channel use; else REFUTES the 'pop it once they're all in the storm' note
